import math

def is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
    """Return whether n is prime."""
    # Handle common edge cases
    if n < 2:
        return False
    if n in (2, 3):
        return True
    # Eliminate multiples of 2 and 3 quickly
    if n % 2 == 0 or n % 3 == 0:
        return False
    # Check divisors up to sqrt(n) using 6k +/- 1 optimization
    limit = int(math.isqrt(n))
    i = 5
    while i <= limit:
        if n % i == 0 or n % (i + 2) == 0:
            return False
        i += 6
    return True
